   protocol with TB2 catalogue identity, outcome-blind
   eligible/excluded set, dev/held-out separation, fixed
   arm/control/trigger/model-role/cap factors, 30-task seeded
   selection without replacement under supplied quotas, task-level

2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.41.md` and its PR record; index only

3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged (R5.15 population/plan
   contract + MethodMetadata, R5.39 parity admission, R5.36–R5.38
   method spine, §6.3 experiment scheduling records). A new
   shared/persisted decision belongs in the owning ADR admission,
   never an implementation-local substitute.

## Plan

**Placement.** `crates/hh-eval/src/central_protocol.rs` + acceptance
battery `crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_41.rs`. Rationale: the M-H memo's
"Depends M-A plan contract + owning experiment scheduling" makes
hh-eval the only cycle-free home that consumes the M-A contract
(`population::MethodMetadata`, the `(task, split, stratum, arm,
replicate)` slot vocabulary) *and* the owning §6.3 scheduling records
(`hharness_lab::experiment::{SchedulingPolicy, ReattemptPolicy}`,
`bench` manifests) unchanged — hh-eval already depends on hh-lab;
hh-lab cannot consume hh-eval. Same home as the R5.36–R5.40 method
spine; fails-without = compile-red at the R5.40 base.

**Shape.** `materialize_protocol(decl: &ProtocolDecl) ->
Result<MaterializedProtocol, ProtocolError>` — pure, records-in,
deterministic (no clocks/stores). Decl supplies the external gated
inputs verbatim (suite/manifest pins, eligible tasks, exclusions,
dev/held-out split, quotas, seed, arms/roles, lanes, SchedulingPolicy,
ReattemptPolicy, warmth, route/cache/seed/fingerprint support, drift,
phase/family/stop ids, zero-search flags, change-control). Output:
`protocol_id` (`idp_digest` under `central_protocol` domain —
a derived commitment, no new RecordKind/event class), 30-task
selection, 5-round × 2-arm interleaved schedule (300 slots),
first-slot bindings, phase/family/stop identities, slot-set hash,
S.1 `MethodMetadata`. Strict `to_json` + `check_id()`.

**Determinism.** Seeded ranks via `idp_digest` (the same scheme
`expand::order_key` uses): `select` rank per (seed,stratum,task)
satisfies quotas without replacement and equal within-stratum weights;
`order` rank randomizes task order; `coin` bit is the fair task-level
lane coin. Slot refs derived `H(seed ∥ task ∥ arm ∥ replicate)`.
Same inputs ⇒ byte-identical output and `protocol_id`.

**Refusals (closed `ProtocolError`).** `OutcomeSelectedExclusion`,
`DevOverlap`, `LateSplit`, `InsufficientHeldOut`, `QuotaMismatch`,
`UndeclaredStratum`, `ConflictingTask`, `ArmSet` (≠{evict_oldest,
clear_tool_results} / third arm), `PolicySearch`, `TaskConditioned`,
`ArtificialPressure`, `ConcurrencyCap`, `ArmConcurrency`,
`OrderPolicy`, `RetryCeiling`, `WrongAnswerRetry`,
`UnfrozenRetryClasses`, `UnknownWarmth`, `Drift`, `SupportMismatch`,
`RolesChanged`, `ChangedAfterSubjects`, `PilotRelabel`,
`UnpublishedExclusions`, `MissingKey`, `Schema`.

**No-go lines.** No participant data, no live execution, no task/seed/
quota choice, no new dependency/RecordKind/event class/kernel arm, no
scientific claim. Records-in only — the caller resolves suite/task
records (scratch fixtures in tests).

  (selection/coin/schedule/first-slots/identity gates) vs the
  scheduling-validation leg (concurrency/order/retry/warmth/
  support/drift/change-control) — **rejected as non-curative**:
  M-H :147 is one scope sentence (materialize *and* validate);
  `materialize_protocol` is a single closed-predicate function
  over one error union — no prefix is an admitted state (an
  unvalidated materialization would silently mint protocol
  identities — the exact failure mode the ticket exists to
  prevent). Impl-vs-battery rejected (R5.22/R5.38/R5.39 precedent:
  no fails-without regression without the test leg). Row-211 is
  one owner row; the ticket is the atom.
- **Recommended ruling:** AMEND (25-AMEND/3-SPLIT history; same
  magnitude band).
